attributes.geology: Interbedded sequence of sandstone and shales

Alternate sequence of sandstone and shale
attributes.triggering: Overloading of slope, high unguided discharge of monsoon rain

attributes.geology: Consists of 50m of shale and minor silt stone with N10°E-S10°W dipping 40° towards SE
Shale sandwiched between sandstone and siltstone and incompetent beds show warps, minor kinks and strike joints.
Variably weathered, thin to thick bedded psemepellite sequence with development of thin to thick weathered mantle
attributes.triggering: Inherent rock mass condition, presence of vulnerable and other discontinuity and high monsoon discharge
